qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Action operates an unbeatable scale-economies-shared discount model: purchasing massive volumes across ~6,000 SKUs and passing 30-50% price savings vs traditional grocers to European consumers, sustaining ~15% EBITDA margins, rapid inventory turnover, and >50% new store-level ROIC.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Premier European compounder dominated by discount retail juggernaut Action (~75-80% of NAV). Action's scale-economies-shared engine delivers 14-16% sales growth, 15% EBITDA margins, and rapid payback on new stores. Simon Borrows has provided exceptional capital allocation and discipline with holdco net debt under 0.1x EBIT.
